d:
Ukraine has launched a major attack on Russia's strategically important Crimea Bridge, reportedly destroying a large section of the 19-kilometre structure. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described it as the result of a military operation lasting several weeks, involving drones and missiles, including the Flamingo cruise missile. The bridge, inaugurated by Vladimir Putin in 2018, connects Russia's mainland with Crimea and serves as a crucial military supply route. Why did Ukraine target it, and what does this mean for Russia?
